extraction_notes: State name, audit year, and report number from cover page. Fiscal indicators are primarily from Table 1.2 (Snapshot of Finances of the State, page 22), Table 1.5 (Compliance with provisions of APFRBM Act, page 25), Chart 1.9 (Fiscal parameters to GSDP, page 27), Table 2.17 (Components of committed expenditure, page 46), and Table 2.31 (Trends in Debt Sustainability Indicators, page 62). GSDP from Table 1.1 (page 15) and outstanding debt from Chart 1.7 (page 25). For audit paras: 'raised_this_year' is the number of grants/appropriations for which reasons for variation were not furnished (page 77, Section 3.6). 'outstanding_over_5_years' is the sum of grants/appropriations with excess expenditure from 2013-14 and 2014-15 requiring regularisation (Table 3.12, page 86). 'pac_recommendations_pending' is set to 0 as no specific count of pending PAC recommendations was found, though non-submission of ENs was noted (page 114). 'money_value_of_observations_crore' is the total excess expenditure for 2019-20 (Appendix 3.9, page 137). Note that the report mentions 'effective' or 'adjusted' deficit figures (e.g., Revenue Deficit 3.17% of GSDP, Fiscal Deficit 6.76% of GSDP if OBBs are included, page 29), but the standard reported figures from the main tables (2.72% and 4.08% respectively) were used as per instructions to use directly stated values from accounts.
